reading: DiveDay has 301 server actions — 284 exported from 71 module-level "use server" files and 17 inline closures in 11 pages — so the rule at docs/engineering/workflow.md:66 and .claude/rules/surfaces.md:40 ("server actions default to inline") describes 5.6% of them, and ADR 20260803-invoicing-role-gate:22 already recorded why the inline form was abandoned. Authorization has one documented helper, requireShopSurface (src/lib/session.ts:164), reached by 12 action files and 33 calls, while bare requireStaffSession appears in 44 files and 143 calls, ten files wrap it in a preamble of their own (settingsBlock, teamManagementBlock, paymentSettingsBlock, requireBoardAuthor, requireUnitSurface, requireGearSurface, requireDiverActionContext, requireTripConfig, requireStaffingManager, requirePromoManager), and all 11 [token]/actions.ts files hand-roll the same rate-limit → verify → load preamble that only ready/[token]/actions.ts:90 and shelf/[token]/actions.ts name contextFor. Parsing is 351 formData.get( hand-reads in 47 files beside 150 safeParse( in 36 files. The outcome has three transports — redirect with ?notice= (289 revalidateAndRedirect, 335 noticeUrl, 26 pages each holding their own Record<code,{tone…}> map of which 7 are typed by NoticeCodeOf), return-state for useActionState (30 client consumers, 11 per-file *Result/*FormState types), and void-plus-revalidatePath (check-in/actions.ts:94, divers/[personId]/actions.ts:245, manifest/actions.ts:169) — plus three rival query dialects beside ?notice= (49 files): ?error= in 18 files, ?saved= in 8, ?builder= in schedule/board/actions.ts alone (19 uses). Taking an act back is four grammars chosen per call site — <UndoToast in 13 files, <InlineConfirm in 14, <SendHold in 4, re-tap per docs/design/principles.md §7 — with 13 hand-written inverse actions (undo*/restore*/reinstate*) and the undo target carried through six different URL extras (undo, undoId, bid, noteBody, cardType, id). Of the twenty-two actions read, no two files share a whole shape: settings/actions.ts:217 hand-parses and redirects, manifest/actions.ts:479 zod-parses and returns state inside a try, divers/[personId]/actions.ts:226 redirects on refusal but only revalidates on success, actions/held-sends.ts:80 throws new Error("not_authorized"), and orders/[id]/page.tsx:129-147 runs a four-rung gate ladder (canPersonRefund, hasRequiredStepUp, isDemoShop) as separate redirects. Because the grammar is a convention rather than a type, two guards police it by lexical scan — scripts/check-notice-codes.mjs (371 lines, five syntactic shapes) and scripts/check-redirect-in-try.mjs (439 lines) — and trips/[id]/actions.authz.test.ts:31-48 mocks five modules to test one action's gate. The one place a per-surface decision is data is src/app/actions/seat-diver-surfaces.ts (seatedPath, refusedPath, gateScope, three notice codes per door), and the one place take-back is a property of the act rather than a component is src/app/actions/held-sends.ts (hold/undo/release over one held_sends row).

ideas.title: One declared action replaces ten preambles and three outcome transports
ideas.reading: Of 301 actions (284 module-level in 71 files, 17 inline in 11 pages), 12 files reach requireShopSurface (src/lib/session.ts:164) and 44 call requireStaffSession bare, ten of them behind a preamble of their own (settingsBlock, teamManagementBlock, paymentSettingsBlock, requireBoardAuthor, requireUnitSurface, requireGearSurface, requireDiverActionContext, requireTripConfig, requireStaffingManager, requirePromoManager). All 11 [token]/actions.ts files call checkRateLimit and then verify and load by hand; only ready/[token]/actions.ts:90 and shelf/[token]/actions.ts name the preamble contextFor. Input is read by hand 351 times in 47 files (formData.get() and by schema 150 times in 36 (safeParse(). The answer travels three ways: 289 revalidateAndRedirect + 335 noticeUrl into 26 page-local notice maps (7 typed by NoticeCodeOf), 11 per-file *Result/*FormState types returned to 30 useActionState consumers, and bare revalidatePath on check-in/actions.ts:94 and divers/[personId]/actions.ts:245. Beside ?notice= (49 files) three dialects survive: ?error= in 18 files (80 uses), ?saved= in 8 (24), ?builder= in schedule/board/actions.ts (19). The same gate is a redirect in trips/[id]/actions.ts:300, a notFound() in inbox/actions.ts:56, a throw new Error("not_authorized") in actions/held-sends.ts:80 and a four-rung ladder in orders/[id]/page.tsx:129-147. src/app/actions/seat-diver-surfaces.ts already proves the alternative: four doors share one seatDiver consequence and differ only by a data row (seatedPath, refusedPath, gateScope, three notice codes).
ideas.idea: A single defineAction in src/lib/action.ts (beside session.ts, which already imports next/navigation) turns a declaration into the server action: gate ("staff", a ShopSurfaceGate with its refusal, or bearer(purpose, rateLimit)), input (a zod schema), run(ctx, input) (one src/db call answering {ok} | {ok:false, reason}), landing(ctx, input) built through shopPath, words: Record<NoticeCodeOf<Reason>, {tone, key}>, and answer: "navigate" | "inline". The pipeline is then the only code that calls requireShopSurface, safeParse, trackEvent, revalidateAndRedirect and noticeUrl, and a reason with no words is a compile error at the declaration rather than a silent blank banner. answer: "inline" hands the same {ok, reason, values} to useActionState and the folded FormStatus (ADR 20260908-one-hand 20d) instead of redirecting, so the two transports carry one message and a surface picks by declaring, not by writing a second action shape. The 26 page maps move onto the actions that produce their codes — still per surface, which is the reason staff-notices.ts:8-13 keeps them local, but beside the act rather than the render — and the page draws one <ActionOutcome>. ?error=, ?saved= and ?builder= become noticeUrl extras or are deleted; the ten preamble helpers, the 351 hand-reads and the bearer files' eleven copies of rate-limit → verify → load go with them. Shared actions keep their per-door table: SeatSurface becomes the landing/words half of a defineAction, unchanged in content.
ideas.dissolves: The ten per-file gate helpers, the eleven hand-rolled bearer preambles and the three rival outcome transports; a server action becomes a declaration rather than an assembly.
ideas.scope: src/lib/action.ts (+ action.test.ts); 71 action files and the 11 pages holding inline closures (301 actions); 26 notice maps in src/app; e2e assertions on ?error=/?builder= (18 + 1 files); docs/engineering/workflow.md:66, .claude/rules/surfaces.md:40, docs/architecture/overview.md; one ADR. Notice codes and bundle keys are kept, so en-US and es-ES are untouched.
ideas.firstSlice: Ship defineAction with gate: "staff" | ShopSurfaceGate and answer: "navigate", and convert the 39 actions of settings/actions.ts — every one already runs requireStaffSession → settingsBlock → shopPath(…, "settings") → noticeUrl(…, { saved }) — deleting settingsBlock and the hand-passing of saved.
ideas.conflicts: workflow.md 'server actions default to inline' (settled shape, brief line 74) — measured at 17 of 301, with ADR 20260803-invoicing-role-gate:22 recording why the form was left; ADR 20260908-one-hand 20d (ActionResultNotice → FormStatus) is where the inline answer lands, extended not contradicted; ADR 20260724-role-authorization and ADR-0006 (server re-checks) are honoured because the gate is re-read live inside the pipeline; issues #1869/#1855 (confirm-to-clear copy) untouched.

ideas.title: Take-it-back is a property the action declares, not a component
ideas.reading: Taking an act back is four grammars chosen at the call site: <UndoToast in 13 files, <InlineConfirm in 14, <SendHold in 4, and re-tap on the settled control (docs/design/principles.md §7, check-in/actions.ts:80-90). docs/design/principles.md §7 and ADR 20260906-before-you-ask §2/§4 already state the rule — reversible → undo, a holdable send → hold, an unholdable send or money → confirm, a toggle → re-tap — and its four carve-outs (sign out, an untouched departure, a recap photo, a booking inside the refund window). Thirteen inverse actions are hand-written (undoRemoveBookingAction, restoreCardAction, restoreDiverNoteAction, restoreInternalNoteAction, restorePersonAction, restoreGearItemAction, restorePromoAction, restoreStaffAction, restoreDiveSitesAction, reinstateTripAction, undoCheckInAction, undoNoShowAction, undoHeldSendAction), each a preamble around one src/db restore. The undo target rides in six different noticeUrl extras (undo, undoId, bid, noteBody, cardType, id) and each page re-wires UndoToast with its own hidden fields (UndoToast.tsx:26-43 is 'deliberately generic'). InlineConfirm is client-only (ui/InlineConfirm.tsx:62-67: 'nothing here is optimistic'), so the server never learns a confirm was required and a crafted POST reaches the action without the second tap. The one act modelled as a property is the held send: holdSendAction / undoHeldSendAction / releaseHeldSendAction over one held_sends row for three declared kinds (src/lib/held-sends.ts:26).
ideas.idea: The L20-1 declaration gains takeBack: { kind: "undo", inverse } | { kind: "hold" } | { kind: "confirm" } | { kind: "retap" } | "none", and the pipeline does what the kind says. undo: the landing carries { undo: id } and the page's one <ActionOutcome> renders UndoToast bound to a single generic undoAction(actionId, id) that dispatches to the declared inverse through a registry shaped like HELD_SEND_KINDS — the 13 inverse exports become 13 registry rows, each still calling the src/db restore that holds the real re-checks (restoreBooking's capacity and ratio refusals stay where they are). hold: the pipeline writes the held_sends row and returns the HeldTicket, which is what holdSendAction already does for three kinds; a fourth send declares itself and gets the hold without touching held-sends.ts. confirm: the pipeline refuses a submission that lacks the confirmed field InlineConfirm posts, so the second tap is proved on the server. retap: answer: "inline" and no toast — the settled control is the affordance, as check-in/actions.ts:80-90 argues. Principles §7's rule becomes a check on the declaration: a run that soft-deletes must declare undo, one that sends must declare hold or confirm, and the four carve-outs are confirm declarations rather than exceptions in prose.
ideas.dissolves: The 13 hand-written inverse actions and the per-call-site choice among UndoToast, InlineConfirm, SendHold and re-tap.
ideas.scope: src/lib/action.ts; UndoToast.tsx, SendHold.tsx, ui/InlineConfirm.tsx kept as renderers chosen by the pipeline; the 13 inverse actions across trips/[id], divers/[personId], check-in, gear, promos, settings/team, settings/dive-site-import, actions/held-sends; the six undo extras; docs/design/principles.md §7; e2e specs on the 13 UndoToast surfaces; an ADR amending 20260906 §2/§4. No bundle changes: Undo, Sent and the confirm labels already exist.
ideas.firstSlice: Add takeBack: { kind: "undo", inverse } and the generic undoAction, and convert the five restore pairs on divers/[personId]/actions.ts (cards, notes, person) and trips/[id]/actions.ts (internal note, booking) — deleting five exports and five toast wirings.
ideas.conflicts: docs/design/principles.md §7 as amended by ADR 20260906-before-you-ask §4 — this makes the amendment a type rather than a sentence; ADR 20260911-the-confirm-tap-is-the-release (a no-show frees the seat on the confirm tap, no second act) becomes a confirm declaration, unchanged in behaviour; ADR 20260906 §2's four carve-outs become confirm declarations; ADR 20260820-every-delete-is-soft is what makes undo the default for a delete; issues #1869/#1855 (confirm-to-clear copy) untouched.

ideas.title: Make the action grammar a type and retire two grep guards
ideas.reading: docs/engineering/workflow.md:66 and .claude/rules/surfaces.md:40 say 'server actions default to inline'; 17 of 301 actions are inline (5.6%). ADR 20260803-invoicing-role-gate:22 records why the form was left ('any gate added to it could only be exercised through the page — precisely the layer a crafted POST skips') and manifest/actions.ts:43-62 records the same move for 17 more. Because any file may emit ?notice= and call redirect, two lexical guards police the convention: scripts/check-notice-codes.mjs (371 lines, five syntactic shapes, the fifth added for the done/backTo helpers of three files) and scripts/check-redirect-in-try.mjs (439 lines). 24 actions*.test.ts files cover 47 actions.ts; trips/[id]/actions.authz.test.ts:31-48 mocks next/navigation, next/cache, @/db/client, @/lib/session and @/lib/analytics to reach one gate. src/lib/session.ts:153-162 explains that the helper's contract can only be pinned in callers by a script 'because the failure renders nothing, so nothing goes red'.
ideas.idea: With L20-1 the emitter of ?notice= and the caller of redirect inside an action are one function, so the grammar is proved by the type and the guards shrink: check-notice-codes keeps only its reader shape (notice === "literal") and check-redirect-in-try drops the action roots and keeps guarding pages. workflow.md and surfaces.md are rewritten to the measured truth — a mutation is a defineAction declaration in the segment's actions.ts; an inline closure is the exception and names its reason — and a 30-line guard refuses a "use server" file exporting an async function not built by defineAction. Action tests stop mocking the framework: src/lib/action.test.ts proves the pipeline once (gate throws, refusal lands, reason → code, inline answer), and each action's test calls its run with a seededShopContext. AGENTS.md's check:repo count falls by two and docs/agents/repo-checks.md loses two entries.
ideas.dissolves: The inline-default rule, the emitter halves of two lexical guards, and the five-mock test ladder per gated action.
ideas.scope: docs/engineering/workflow.md:66-69, .claude/rules/surfaces.md:40, docs/agents/repo-checks.md, scripts/check-notice-codes.mjs (+ .test.mjs), scripts/check-redirect-in-try.mjs (+ .test.mjs), scripts/check-repo.mjs, AGENTS.md check:repo row, src/lib/session.ts:153-162 docblock, 24 action test files.
ideas.firstSlice: Rewrite workflow.md:66-69 and surfaces.md:40 to the measured default (a sibling actions.ts taking a bound context; inline is the exception) citing ADR 20260803-invoicing-role-gate — a one-PR doc fix that is true today, before any code moves.
ideas.conflicts: The settled 'server actions default to inline' (brief line 74, workflow.md:66) — the measurement is that practice reversed it on 2026-08-03 and the rule was never updated; .claude/rules/scripts.md 'a guard gets a test beside it' and 'a guard is spawned by check-repo.mjs' — the retired guards' tests and rows go with them; ADR 20260723-event-instrumentation (trackEvent seam) unchanged, only its call site moves into the pipeline.
